concept: 腾挪 vs 闪击的区别
question_cn: 腾挪（Clearance）和闪击（Discovered Attack）都涉及移走己方棋子，它们的根本区别是什么？
question_en: Both clearance and discovered attacks involve moving one of your own pieces. What is the fundamental difference?

options.text_cn: 腾挪只能由兵执行，闪击只能由轻子执行
options.text_en: Only pawns can make clearance moves, while only minor pieces can create discovered attacks

options.text_cn: 腾挪是为己方另一个棋子清出路径；闪击是移走己方棋子后，被遮挡的己方棋子突然威胁对方
options.text_en: Clearance opens a route for another friendly piece; a discovered attack occurs when moving a piece reveals an attack by a friendly piece behind it

options.text_cn: 腾挪必须牺牲棋子，闪击不需要牺牲
options.text_en: Clearance always requires a sacrifice, while a discovered attack does not

options.text_cn: 两者相同，区别只在于是否将军
options.text_en: They are the same tactic; the only difference is whether the move gives check

explanation_cn: 腾挪关注的是「为谁让路」：移走的棋子让出路径，受益者是另一个己方子（如象走开，后冲入）。闪击关注的是「暴露谁」：移走的棋子让开，后方被遮挡的己方子突然亮出攻击线。本题Nf6+马腾挪清e列，受益者是Re1冲入Re8#——典型腾挪。
explanation_en: Clearance asks, “Who gets the route?” The piece that moves away clears a path for another friendly piece, such as a bishop moving so the queen can enter. A discovered attack asks, “Whose attack is revealed?” The piece moves to uncover an attack line from a piece behind it. Here, Nf6+ clears the e-file for Re1 to play Re8#.
